ENGINEERING NOTES / EN

Application notes

Which feeder suits my packaging?

Examine the material as it arrives. A continuous carrier provides a pitch reference for the SRT7001 drive and cutter.

For loose pieces, inspect the S-MVF02 bulk feeder drawing. A sample trial should establish how consistently that terminal can be oriented.

How should we measure strip pitch?

Measure from the same feature on one terminal to the next. Include a dimensioned strip drawing and show the winding direction.

Mark the pickup face on a photo so the cut station and the host tool can be reviewed together.

What makes a cut acceptable?

Agree on the permitted carrier remnant and allowable deformation of the tab. Inspect a sample under the conditions used by your quality team.

Use the same criteria after a reel change to check that threading and setup produce the required result.

How much room does the gripper need?

Map the tool envelope as it approaches, closes and retracts. Include clearance around the terminal leads.

Check the released part in its nest with the actual nozzle or gripper and record the working pickup coordinate.

How do we budget cycle time?

Time the feed, wait, pick and insertion steps individually. The published 0.8 s figure is the time to supply a terminal.

Record which motions can overlap on your host machine before calculating the finished assembly rate.

How does the shortage alarm work?

The model sheet specifies an alarm after three consecutive checks without material.

During commissioning, agree with the operator on the refill, acknowledgement and restart sequence.

What should go into an interface review?

The model sheet describes PLC control, host I/O and independent operation. Prepare the host signal list and request the current wiring diagram.

Agree on the meaning of ready, request, complete and fault signals with the integrator before running a trial.

What belongs in the sample trial?

Send a representative reel with the production drawing and a known good terminal for comparison.

Record the terminal orientation, cut quality, pickup success and timings against acceptance criteria agreed with your team.
